538:t_1:86.en:
$$レド$$
「...I must have been just like them when I was a soldier of the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

538:t_1:88.en:
$$レド$$
「But now, though I have doubts and worries, I believe I am stronger than I was then.」

538:t_1:90.en:
$$アルト$$
「That means you're just like $$宗介$$ and $n, $$レド$$.」

538:t_1:91.en:
$n
「You're lumping us together as the quiet type?」

538:t_1:93.en:
$n
「Of course. I'm not the quiet type anymore, anyway.」

538:t_1:94.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You sure are hung up on that.」

538:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「He heard it so often during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

538:t_1:96.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm saying you've gotten stronger despite your worries!」

538:t_1:97.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you were saying something that obvious.」

538:t_1:98.en:
$n
「I know that without you telling me.」

538:t_1:100.en:
$$マオ$$
「Too bad, $$アルト$$. You were trying so hard to sound cool.」

538:t_1:103.en:
$$レド$$
「Having someone recognize you is a good feeling.」

538:t_1:105.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「...I feel like I understand what makes $$キリコ$$ and $c strong now.」

538:t_1:106.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right! This crazy racket is the source of our strength!」

538:t_1:108.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「I... wonder if I can become like you...」

538:t_1:109.en:
$$カレン$$
「You already have. You've learned what it means to fight for someone, $$テイタニア$$.」

538:t_1:111.en:
$$テイタニア$$
($$フィアナ$$... The feelings you entrusted to me have changed me...)

538:t_1:112.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I will keep following $$キリコ$$... even if my feelings never reach him.)

538:t_2:6.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「You're the $$触れ得ざる者$$... $$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:7.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Where is $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$?」

538:t_2:8.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「When His Holiness learned you had come, he went to obtain God's protection...」

538:t_2:9.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I am asking where he is.」

538:t_2:10.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「I-I don't know! I truly don't know!」

538:t_2:11.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「Only the Pope is told where to receive divine revelations!」

538:t_2:13.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「I shall tell you, $$触れ得ざる者$$.」

538:t_2:15.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「I am the 712th Pope... $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$' predecessor.」

538:t_2:16.en:
$$枢機卿$$
「Your Holiness! What on earth are you doing!?」

538:t_2:17.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「The $$触れ得ざる者$$, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$...」

538:t_2:19.en:
$$テオ８世$$
「This outcome was decided... the moment we laid a hand on him...」

538:t_2:25.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「As your apostle, O ruler of the laws of $$アストラギウス$$... no, of the universe, I have come before you with a request!」

538:t_2:26.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Have mercy on me, who guided the people and embodied your laws... on the $$マーティアル$$ Church and on me, its current Pope!」

538:t_2:27.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$! That man's very existence is an abomination that threatens the Church!」

538:t_2:28.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「With your divine majesty, pass judgment upon him!」

538:t_2:29.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「Why!? Why will you not answer me, God!」

538:t_2:30.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ$$ is the man who defied God, killed God, and disgraced $$マーティアル$$, God's Church...!」

538:t_2:31.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I sacrificed my daughter and stained my own hands with blood for this position...! And that man destroyed it... the glory of $$マーティアル$$...!」

538:t_2:32.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「God! Grant me your mercy and power!」

538:t_2:34.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「$$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:35.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Now that I am here, I have no use for you.」

538:t_2:36.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「You dare... ignore me, the Pope!?」

538:t_2:40.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「So even the $$触れ得ざる者$$ is shaken when the woman he loves, who should be dead, turns out to be alive!」

538:t_2:41.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「I wanted to see that expression! Die, $$キリコ・キュービィー$$!」

538:t_2:44.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「God... Will you... choose... $$キリコ$$...?」

538:t_2:46.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「That is correct, $$キリコ$$. You are not permitted to die here.」

538:t_2:47.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$ワイズマン#pilot$$... Weren't you supposed to have died on Planet $$クエント$$?」

538:t_2:48.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「I did not die completely. In the final instant before my functions ceased, I transferred my will to the system here.」

538:t_2:49.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「As a god, I will rise to greater heights... For that, I still need your existence.」

538:t_2:50.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So you contacted me through the collective unconscious to absorb me.」

538:t_2:51.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「In our previous battle, I sensed that you were advancing toward the truth of the universe.」

538:t_2:52.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Thus I knew the day would come when you touched it and sensed my existence.」

538:t_2:53.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Answer me. What is a god?」

538:t_2:54.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「God as a concept perished long ago.」

538:t_2:55.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Those who call themselves gods in this universe now are beings known as higher-dimensional life-forms.」

538:t_2:57.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「They may once have been called humans.」

538:t_2:58.en:
$$ワイズマン#pilot$$
「Through various processes, they touched the truth of the universe and attained eternity.」
